embeds.description:
To join **Oath Forsaken**, pick the application that fits you.

<:ironsworn:1558623401302564996> **Ironman** — you play an ironman.

<:unbound:1558623453438025828> **Main** — you play a main.

<:guest:1558634092185002035> **Guest** — you are just visiting or here for a friend.

embeds.title: WELCOME TO OATH FORSAKEN
embeds.description:
⛧ Oath Forsaken is an ironman-centric clan for scapers who love the grind. We PvM together, we skill together, and we hang out.

⛧ Ironmen get the full experience: bingos and WOM competitions.

⛧ Mains are welcome too. Earn seniority, join casual events, be part of the clan.

⛧ Just visiting? Come say hi as a guest.

⛧ Pick the application below that fits you and we will get you sorted.
